coreMechanic: choose river spot, charge cast, distinguish nibble from bite, hook and alternate reeling with release
skill: spot and distance selection, hook timing, readable fish tension
score: total fishing score in one completed five-minute standard outing
failure: early/late hooks and excessive tension lose that fish; outing continues
practice: untimed independent outing; no local BEST, ranking candidate or production RUN
save: validated local-only standard:r1 score; original games unchanged

inputs.keyboard: A/D or arrows move; Space hold/release cast; Space/Enter hook or hold reel; Escape pause
inputs.touch: left/right buttons; one phase-labelled CAST/HOOK/REEL action; hold release with pointercancel cleanup

prototypeStatus: trial; technical QA distinct from author enjoyment
telemetry: existing lifecycle + specific_game_events sparse fishing observations; external OFF until actual Worker registration
rights: original gameplay, generated natural art with provenance; no third-party fishing game assets/code
